title: Fulgurites in Giza iron veins as evidence of high-voltage current

tellings.quote: In these iron ore veins, we have samples that contain fulgurites, which is evidence of high-voltage electric current distribution through these iron veins.

plain: Samples taken from iron ore veins under the Giza plateau in Egypt are said to contain fulgurites, glassy tubes that form when strong electric current, like lightning, melts rock. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum says this is "evidence of high-voltage electric current distribution through these iron veins". If so, it would point to an ancient energy grid beneath the pyramids.
